events.comment: The content (chapters, archangels, shadow-thoughts, gifts…) comes from assets/data/content.json, built by tools/build-content.mjs. The save lives in the browser storage and is merged over the defaults of the global variable Save.
A chapter's intro starts with its content note (if it has one); every scene then loads its lines with the person's forms resolved (HolyHoly::LoadScene).
Before heavy chapters: what is coming, help lines where it matters, and a way to skip the chapter without losing progress.

parameters: "Pomoc całą dobę: " + Content.story.helplinesShort + NewLine() + "To gra, nie terapia. Możesz w każdej chwili przerwać."

events.comment: Space, Enter, a click or "Dalej" moves on; "Pomiń" ends the scene. The panel changes only when the line names a new one, with a short fade.
A new painting: the old one fades out, the new one fades in, covering the screen above the text.
Veiled mode: where Christ is painted, only light is seen (for those whose tradition does not portray Him).
